## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes.
- [ ] A test fails without this change.
- [ ] Check logic lives in `packages/core`, not in a wrapper.
- [ ] Any new check has a fixture; binary tile fixtures are generated by
      `scripts/build-fixtures.mjs`, not committed.
- [ ] Severity follows the evidence: a partial sample never produces `broken`,
      and a check that could not run reports incomplete rather than passing.
- [ ] `site/index.html` updated if behaviour changed.
- [ ] `npm run bundle:action` re-run and the bundle committed, if action or core
      sources changed.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under `Unreleased`, if this is user-visible.
